pa_resist_feudalism = {
	estate = burghers_estate
	estate = peasants_estate

	potential = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		always = no
		NOT = {
			always = no
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			always = no
			always = no
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				always = no
				always = no
			}
			order_by = population
			max = {
				value = 1
				add = {
					value = num_provinces
					divide = 20
				}
			}
			change_institution_progress = {
				type = institution:antq_hellenism
				value = institution_progress_mild_penalty
			}
		}
	}
	chance = 10
}
